text.en:
There is hereby created a bureau to be known as the Bureau of Labor under the administrative
supervision and control of the Department of Labor.

The Secretary of Labor, with the approval of the President, is hereby authorized to transfer from
his Department to the Bureau of Labor such personnel, equipment, appropriation and records as, in his opinion
are essential to the proper functioning of said bureau.

The sum of forty thousand two hundred pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby
appropriated out of the funds of the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated for the salaries of the
Director of Labor at seven thousand two hundred pesos per annum;five labor agents at two thousand four
hundred pesos each, or twelve thousand pesos per annum; five labor agents at one thousand eight hundred
pesos each, or nine thousand per annum; and ten labor agents at one thousand two hundred pesos each, or
twelve thousand pesos per annum, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 15, 1945.
